caption: How to get off the floor without using your hands: four rungs with the full movement name, the tier, the reps and the exact test that says you are ready for the next one. Supported Sit-to-Stand, Sit-to-Stand, Paused Squat, Elevated Split Squat, then Single-Leg Sit-to-Stand at the top. Getting down on the floor with her is free. Getting up is the training. Save the ladder.

overlays.text: Four rungs to standing off the floor without hands.

scenes.footer: Ready for rung two when your hands stop pushing.

overlays.text: Supported Sit-to-Stand, tier 1, eight reps, hands on the chair.

scenes.footer: Ready for rung three when you rise with no rock forward.

overlays.text: Sit-to-Stand, tier 2, eight reps, arms folded.

scenes.footer: Ready for rung four when the pause never becomes a bounce.

overlays.text: Paused Squat, tier 3, eight reps, two seconds at the bottom.

scenes.footer: Ready for the top when both hips stay level for six.

overlays.text: Elevated Split Squat, tier 5, six reps each side.

scenes.footer: No hands. No furniture. That is the capability.

overlays.text: Single-Leg Sit-to-Stand, tier 6, four reps, one leg.

scenes.footer: Climb one rung at a time. You build this.

overlays.text: Rung four takes months, not a week.
